name: compareempire
description: CompareEmpire — a monorepo of price-comparison sites (Camera, Dex, Car, Phone, Laptop) plus the CompareEmpire hub. (RiftCompare runs on a separate instance.)

scripts.install:all: for d in apps/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm install); done
scripts.seed:cameracompare: cd apps/cameracompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:dexcompare: cd apps/dexcompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:carcompare: cd apps/carcompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:phonecompare: cd apps/phonecompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:laptopcompare: cd apps/laptopcompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:mtgcompare: cd apps/mtgcompare && node prisma/gen-cards.mjs && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:opcompare: cd apps/opcompare && node prisma/gen-cards.mjs && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:ygocompare: cd apps/ygocompare && node prisma/gen-cards.mjs && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
